business.name: Momentum Coaching
business.tagline: 1:1 coaching for people who are done staying stuck
business.bio: Momentum Coaching helps ambitious people turn a vague goal into a real plan — and actually follow through on it. No fluff, no 6-month fads. Just weekly accountability, a system that fits your life, and someone in your corner who won't let you quit on yourself.
business.metaDescription: 1:1 coaching to help you set a real plan and follow through. Book a free discovery call.
business.servicesNote: Every client starts with a free 20-minute discovery call — no pressure, just a conversation to see if this is a fit.

hero.headline: Stop Planning To Start. Start.
hero.subheadline: 1:1 coaching that turns your goal into a plan, and your plan into a habit.

services.name: Free Discovery Call
services.description: We talk through where you're stuck, what you actually want, and whether coaching together makes sense. No pitch, no pressure.

services.name: Momentum Sprint
services.description: 4 weekly 1:1 calls, unlimited voice-memo check-ins between sessions, and a plan rebuilt weekly around what's actually happening in your life.

services.name: Momentum Quarter
services.description: 12 weeks of coaching at a discount vs. month-to-month, plus one full 90-minute goal-mapping session at the start and a progress review at the end.

services.name: Momentum Circle (Group Program)
services.description: Small-group coaching (max 6 people), weekly group call, shared accountability thread. For people who want structure without the 1:1 price tag.

reviews.quote: I'd been 'planning to start' for two years. Six weeks in and I've shipped more than the previous two years combined.
reviews.author: Sprint Client

reviews.quote: The weekly calls kept me honest in a way no app or journal ever did. Worth every dollar.
reviews.author: Quarter Client

reviews.quote: The group program gave me accountability I couldn't afford to skip on my own — and it's a fraction of the 1:1 price.
reviews.author: Circle Member
